literal: Two waters and, endowed mountain and, coming water and, strong fortress and, to a country, limbs.
translation: Two sources of water, well-situated mountains, flowing rivers, and strong fortresses are the essential limbs of a country.
modern: மேல்நீர் கீழ்நீர் ஆகிய இருவகை நீர்நிலைகளும், தக்க இடத்தில் அமைந்த மலையும், அதிலிருந்து வரும் ஆற்று நீரும், வலிய கோட்டையும் ஒரு நாட்டிற்கு உறுப்புகளாகும்.
explanation: This couplet lists the essential physical features that make up a secure and prosperous country. 'Irupuṉal' refers to two types of water sources, typically understood as ground water and surface water. Along with these, well-placed mountains, flowing rivers, and strong fortresses serve as the vital organs or limbs ('uṟuppu') of a nation, providing both sustenance and defense.
